brand-primary.$description: Brand orange (palette, #FF7A3A). DECORATIVE USE ONLY per Brand Book v1.0 (p.16). Allowed: filled-icon fills, blob shapes, accents, borders. NEVER use as section/button text-background; orange + white text fails contrast (2.59:1, p.19). Orange icons must always carry a text label (p.18). Sanctioned structural exceptions: the QR-code border (p.33) and the white standalone logo icon on an orange background for social profile images / print covers with no text (p.12).

brand-secondary.$description: Brand blue (palette, #3F00EB). Special announcements and alerts; always pair with white text (#FFF). Elementor Global 1.

brand-dark.$description: Charcoal (palette, #1E1E1E)—primary text on light backgrounds. Elementor Global 3.

accent.$description: Warm white (palette, #FDFCF6)—text-heavy content backgrounds; pair with Charcoal text. Corrected from #FDFCF7 to match the 2026 palette on the brand board. Elementor Global 4.

focus-button.$description: Focus Button (#CC622E)—primary button hover/pressed state (Elementor Custom 1)

light-purple.$description: Lavender (palette, #D5C5FF)—decorative: blobs, icons, accents, borders. NEVER a background (Brand Book v1.0 p.16); use Soft Lavender for large readable backgrounds. Do not place Lavender accents on a Soft Lavender background (too close in tone, p.16). Elementor Custom 2.

soft-lavender.$description: Soft lavender (palette, #E5DCFF)—social/layout backgrounds; pair with Charcoal text. Map in Elementor as an additional Custom Color if available.

lavender-official.$description: Official light lavender (2026 Color Guidelines, #E5D0FF). USE SPARINGLY—decorative accent only. Distinct from Soft Lavender #E5DCFF (layout bg) and lavender.300 #E6DCFF (ramp).

light-green.$description: Lime green (palette, #D4E6AB)—title/key layout backgrounds; pair with Charcoal; decorative accents. Corrected from #D4E6A8 to match the 2026 palette on the brand board. Elementor Custom 3.

light-orange.$description: Light Orange (#FFD7C4)—soft CTA background, hover tint (Elementor Custom 4)

very-light-gray.$description: Very Light Gray (#F7F7F7)—light section backgrounds (Elementor Custom 8)

teal-deep.$description: Deep teal (2026 palette, #0F6E6E). Primary-row colour on the brand board; dark enough for white text. Distinct from color.teal #03C9D3, the decorative Elementor Custom 6 accent.

magenta.$description: Magenta (2026 palette, #BE2A6B). Primary-row colour on the brand board; pair with white text. Approved as a background in the board's approved-combinations panel.

navy.$description: Navy (2026 palette, #1F3A6E). Primary-row colour on the brand board; dark ground, pair with white text.

blush.$description: Blush (2026 palette, #FADCD2). Secondary-row colour on the brand board; light ground, pair with Charcoal text.

yellow.$description: Amber yellow (2026 palette, #F6C445). Secondary-row colour on the brand board; light ground, pair with Charcoal text. Never place white text on it.

red.$description: Brand red (2026 palette, #C43A2E). Secondary-row colour on the brand board; pair with white text. Distinct from color.status.error #DC2626, the form-error signal.

warm-grey-light.$description: Warm light greige (2026 palette, #C9BFAE). Neutral-row colour on the brand board; warm alternative to the pure-grey neutral ramp for borders and muted surfaces.

warm-grey.$description: Mid warm grey (2026 palette, #989389). Neutral-row colour on the brand board; warm alternative to neutral.400/500 for muted text and dividers.

background-default.$description: Semantic — text-heavy content background. Alias of Warm White (#FDFCF6); pair with Charcoal text.

background-soft.$description: Semantic — decorative content background (cards, sections). Alias of Soft Lavender (#E5DCFF); pair with Charcoal text.

background-title.$description: Semantic — title / key layout background. Alias of Lime Green (#D4E6AB); pair with Charcoal text.

background-alert.$description: Semantic — special announcements / alerts only. Alias of Brand Blue (#3F00EB); pair with white text.

accent-icon.$description: Semantic — filled-icon fill (category markers). Alias of Brand Orange (#FF7A3A); pair with Charcoal labels or white glyph inside the icon shape only.

accent-border.$description: Semantic — decorative border / underline accent. Alias of Brand Orange (#FF7A3A); never use as a fill background for elements containing text.

focus-ring.$description: Semantic — Charcoal focus outline (#1E1E1E). ~17:1 on light brand backgrounds. Retained for non-keyboard/opt-out outlines; keyboard :focus-visible uses focus-visible-accent.

focus-visible-accent.$description: Semantic — warm gold KEYBOARD focus outline (deepened from the marcopontili.com reference to hue 70, ~#CB7F00). Use for :focus-visible only, as a 0.125rem ring at 0.1875rem offset. Contrast 3.19:1 on white, so it clears the WCAG 2.4.11 non-text 3:1 threshold.

theme-2.$description: Charcoal-aligned (#1E1E1E)—primary body text (Theme slot 2); matches palette Charcoal.

theme-8.$description: Theme Color 8 (#1E1E1E)—support text; aligned to Charcoal (Theme slot 8)

purple-home.$description: PRINT ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #6A5AA7). Home/desktop-printer substitute for Brand Blue, which does not print well in CMYK. Home CMYK 68/74/0/0. NEVER load or use on web — digital surfaces use brand-secondary (Blue) instead.

purple-press.$description: PRINT ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #674DA0). Professional-press substitute for Brand Blue in CMYK. Press CMYK 71/82/0/0. NEVER load or use on web.

grey-light.$description: DOCUMENT CHROME ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #F0EDE7). Warm grey for the Brand Book's own tables, callout boxes, and reference notes. NOT part of the ForEveryone brand palette; never use in product UI.

grey-dark.$description: DOCUMENT CHROME ONLY (Brand Book v1.0 p.17, #D7D2CB). Darker warm grey companion to doc.grey-light for document tables/notes. NOT part of the brand palette; never use in product UI.

50.$description: Neutral 50 (#FAFAFA)—lightest surface tint (2026 style guide ramp).

900.$description: Neutral 900 (Neutral_main, #1E1E1E)—Charcoal, primary text on light backgrounds.

150.$description: Orange 150 (#FFD7C4)—light orange surface; aligns with light-orange.

500.$description: Orange 500 (Orange_main, #FF7A3A)—Brand orange. DECORATIVE ONLY: icons, blobs, accents, borders; never a text background.
Green 500 (Green_main, #D4E6AB)—Lime green. Title/key-layout backgrounds with Charcoal text; aligns with light-green/status.success.
Blue 500 (Blue_main, #3F00EB)—Brand blue. Announcements/alerts only; always pair with white text.

300.$description: Lavender 300 (#E6DCFF)—soft lavender; aligns with soft-lavender background.

500.$description: Lavender 500 (Lavender_main, #D5C5FF)—Lavender. Decorative: blobs, icons, accents, borders; aligns with light-purple.
